summary: Frontend-only verification of client-code badge label change on invoices. Admin view shows only the client short-code 'ARS' badge on client-generated invoices; admin-created invoice has no badge; client portal shows no badges and no 'Generated by Client' text; client sees only their own invoices. All 5 test cases PASS.

test_results.admin_label_code_only: PASS - 3 badges rendered with text 'ARS' for the 3 client-generated invoices (data-testid invoice-client-badge-<id>). 'Generated by Client' string NOT found on the page.
test_results.admin_created_no_badge: PASS - Only 3 badges present on admin invoices page (matches the 3 client-generated invoices 5250/5251/5253). Admin-created invoice 5252 has no badge.
test_results.client_portal_hides_label: PASS - 0 elements matching [data-testid^='invoice-client-badge-'] on /client-portal/invoices. 'Generated by Client' text not present. Standalone 'ARS' code not present.
test_results.client_sees_own_invoices: PASS - Client portal shows only 4 invoices, all for Arseas Security Services INC (5250, 5251, 5252, 5253).
test_results.new_client_invoice_tagged: NOT_TESTED - marked optional; existing behavior already verified via backfilled invoices.
